costs.intro: A BMW X3 M Competition engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X3 M engine rebuild starts from £5,500. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes. Genuine BMW M parts carry a documented 30-50% premium over standard components, which is reflected in the Performance-tier pricing.
